results.title: Using AI tools effectively in research - Facebook
results.content: # Postgraduate Support Group | AI Tools Don’t Do Research—You Do | Facebook. Using AI tools effectively in research. AI Tools Don’t Do Research—You Do. ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, CoPilot, Claude, Sutra, Krutrim, Kimi, MyShakti, Mistral—these tools are transforming the way we approach research, but let’s be clear: they are not replacements for the researcher. AI can automate tedious tasks, analyze data at lightning speed, and even generate ideas, but it cannot replace the critical thinking, creativity, and ethical judgment that define meaningful academic work. The real challenge for researchers today is not choosing the right tool but understanding how to use these tools effectively. AI can process data, but it cannot design a research framework. In the age of AI, the most successful researchers will be those who harness these tools to work smarter, not lazier. The future of research isn’t about AI—it’s about researchers who know how to wield AI to its fullest potential.
